ios.desc:
Requires Meta Ray-Ban smart glasses and the Meta AI app. (No glasses yet? Demo Mode previews the full experience.)

Stop living behind a camera.

Keepers turns Meta Ray-Ban smart glasses into an effortless life camera. Start a session and your glasses quietly take a photo every few seconds while you stay in the moment. An AI judge reviews every batch and keeps only the shots worth keeping — genuine laughter, golden light, your dog being ridiculous — and drops the blurry, boring, and duplicate ones before they ever clutter your library.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Pair your Meta Ray-Ban glasses (or try Demo Mode with no glasses at all)
2. Tap Start Capturing and put your phone away
3. Come back to a "Keepers" album holding just the good stuff

DAILY RECAP FILMS
One tap turns any day's keepers into a share-ready vertical video — a date title card, smooth crossfades, gentle motion, and AI-written captions. Save it to your library or share it anywhere.

YOU'RE IN CONTROL
• A selectivity dial from Very strict to Very generous
• Keepers Cloud subscription for zero-setup AI judging, or bring your own OpenAI/Gemini API key, or keep every photo with no AI
• Adjustable capture interval, from every 5 seconds to every 5 minutes
• A live viewfinder with a manual shutter for the shots you want on purpose
• Capture-sound toggle and clear capture transparency
• A Library that shows every day's keepers and sessions in one place

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Photos go from your glasses to your phone to your photo library. AI judging processes photos transiently and stores nothing. No accounts, no tracking.

Keepers is an independent app and is not affiliated with Meta. Glasses features require Meta Ray-Ban smart glasses with the Meta AI app; every other feature works on any iPhone in Demo Mode.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://keepers-cloud.web.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://keepers-cloud.web.app/privacy

quotes.text:
The Meta Display glasses very recently opened up their software to third party developers. So I made Keepers!

Keepers uses your glasses camera to capture photos or videos every 10 seconds (configurable) and uses AI to judge if those are worth keeping (works in background and locked mode). There are other features like daily recaps, and the fact that these get stored directly onto your phone (something the glasses native camera does not do).

iOS App: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/keepers-smart-glasses-camera/id6792932390

Android App: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ggaswint.keepers

Looking for users, feedback, new feature requests. I have already gotten tons of use out of this.

Personally i don't like having to press the glasses button for a photo or video. I feel like it's laggy and i often don't catch the moments I want. This app allows me to turn it on, then go play with my daughter and at the end of our fun session I get a ton of photos and highlights of our time. I hope other's will find this app enjoyable as well :)

Anyone else here own a pair of the meta rayban display glasses?
